description: Explicit zero-plausible-gap proof for the SystemVerilog preprocessor formal-closure surface. RE-BASELINED 2026-06-09 (PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0052, leaf GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.5.2): allowed_unreachable_rules tightened [trivia] -> [] and allowed_unreachable_branches tightened [branch::trivia::root/q#0..2] -> [], version 2 -> 3. The dead `trivia` rule (`(space_or_tab | line_comment | block_comment)*`) was the SOLE tolerated helper-pocket: it was referenced by NO rule (every rule uses the line-comment-free `inline_trivia` sibling) and was therefore OBJECTIVELY unreachable from the entry `systemverilog_preprocessor_file` — proven two independent ways: (A) static reference-graph closure (decidable Hopcroft-Ullman reduced-grammar reachability; PEG references are static literal names; nothing references `trivia`, no @include, entry != trivia), and (B) the independent `--gap-report-json` (`generate_gap_report`) oracle, which reported `trivia reachable=false reason=unreachable_from_entry` as the COMPLETE statically-unreachable-from-entry set while classifying the sibling never-witnessed rules `directive_tail`/`line_comment` as `reachable=true reason=never_hit`. Per the GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED literal-0 doctrine (a dead rule is an EBNF well-formedness defect to remove at source, not a residual to tolerate), `trivia` was removed from `grammars/systemverilog_preprocessor.ebnf`, so the observed unreachable surface is now EMPTY. Tightening the whitelist from [trivia] to [] makes the no-regression invariant STRICTLY STRONGER (any future regression that re-introduces an unreachable rule/branch is now caught). NOT masking: the genuine static-unreachable surface shrank to zero; the contract is updated to the new, better, literal-zero reality. The `directive_tail`/`line_comment` never_hit residuals are reachable (generator-reach) and are driven separately under GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.5.3; they are NOT unreachable debt. Re-baselined per [[feedback_grammar_edit_proof_gate_lockstep]] (a grammar change owns ALL its downstream proof contracts in-slice).
done_rule: Done requires a machine-checkable proof that the syntax-unreachable surface is EMPTY (zero unreachable rules and zero unreachable branches) while the retained aggregate and reachability sidecars still show zero reachable parser/gap debt.
helper_only_whitelist_detail: SystemVerilog preprocessor zero-plausible-gap proof requires the syntax-unreachable surface to be EMPTY — the sole prior helper-pocket rule `trivia` (and its three branches) was removed at source as an unreachable-from-entry dead rule (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.5.2), so the observed unreachable rules and branches must both be the empty set while the aggregate and reachability sidecars remain green.
